subject: Urgent: Production hit during API surge — compensation request
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@retailflux.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: support@retailflux.com
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Production hit during API surge — compensation request

Jonas,

We experienced a severe production impact during a Redwood API surge yesterday (June 6) between about 14:05–14:48 UTC. For roughly 40 minutes our production calls saw timeouts and 5xx spikes across both generation and embeddings routes; latency for generation jumped from a median of ~120ms to >2s, and error rates peaked at ~13%. This hit a key customer demo and forced us to fall back to cached responses.

We need:
- Confirmation of the incident window and root cause
- A remediation / incident summary we can share with our stakeholders
- Compensation in the form of service credits (token credits) and an extension to our trial window while we evaluate failover patterns

Given the customer impact, we're requesting 50k token credits and a 60-day trial extension, or an equivalent commercial gesture. Can you confirm next steps and timeline for a formal write-up?

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Developer Platforms, RetailFlux
alex@retailflux.com
+1 415 555 0198

---
Attachment: error_log_snippet.txt (text)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@retailflux.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Production hit during API surge — compensation request

Alex — thanks for the clear note and sorry for the disruption. I pulled the incident timeline and briefed the on-call. We saw the same spike in 5xx and latency on our side tied to an upstream autoscaling mismatch during a burst of long-sequence generation jobs.

Short answer: we will provide a concise incident summary by EOD PST, and we absolutely want to make this right operationally and commercially.

Initial proposal (subject to approval from Sales Ops):
- 25,000 token goodwill credit applied to your account immediately
- 30-day trial extension while you validate the remediation
- priority incident report and a postmortem meeting with our reliability team (30 min)

I copied Marissa and Stephanie to expedite approvals — if we can do better (higher credit or longer extension) I will push it.

Would you accept the above as a first step while we finalize a full remediation summary?

Warmly,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
